reason: Both are asset-based freight transport operators that sell freight services to B2B shippers for per-shipment or per-voyage fees. They differ in mode and customers. Pangaea runs ocean dry bulk shipping with ice-class vessels and port projects for commodity shippers. XPO runs North American less-than-truckload trucking for industrial and retail shippers. The shared asset-heavy freight model and some overlap among industrial shippers make them adjacent, but the product and the core customers are not the same.
